blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre livre-arbítrio a partir de um e-mail entre orientador e aluno, combinando cortesia acadêmica e rigor.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: capacidade de agir de outro modo

blocks.subject: Re: Thesis chapter on free will
paras: Thank you for the revised chapter. You **posit** that free will is **compatible with** determinism; that is a respectable position, but your argument **hinges on** one premise you never defend: that **being able to do otherwise** is not **required** for responsibility.

**Were** you to address Frankfurt’s cases directly, the chapter **would gain considerably**. **Nor** should you **treat** the incompatibilist objection as **settled**; **rather**, show **why** it fails.
I **would suggest** a **short** section on the **consequence argument** before the conclusion. Please **let me know** when you **have revised** the chapter, and **we can meet**.

items.q: The professor rejects the student’s position entirely.
The argument depends on an undefended premise.
items.why: hinges on one premise you never defend.

items.q: The professor suggests adding a short section.

body: **Hinge on** — depender de
**Beg the question** — pressupor a conclusão
**Stand or fall by** — depender inteiramente de
**Hold water** — ser sólido
**Take issue with** — discordar de
**Be open to question** — estar sujeito a dúvida
**In principle** — em princípio
**Strictly speaking** — a rigor
**For the sake of argument** — para efeito de argumento
**It does not follow that** — não decorre que
**Is my position about free will defensible?** — Minha posição sobre o livre-arbítrio é defensável?
**Respectable, but it hinges on one premise.** — Respeitável, mas depende de uma premissa.

items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.

I didn’t say HE did it.
I didn’t say he DID it.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence email from a supervisor to a student about a philosophy chapter, with praise, a criticism and a suggestion.
blocks.model: Dear Ana, thank you for the revised chapter. Your analysis is careful, and the examples are well chosen. However, your argument hinges on an assumption you never defend. Were you to address it directly, the chapter would gain considerably. Nor should you treat the objection as settled. I would suggest a short new section before the conclusion.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
